mapper.select: SELECT child.id AS tenant_id,g.id AS grant_id,g.revision AS grant_revision, r.id AS relation_ref,r.revision AS relation_revision FROM nw_institution_management_grants g JOIN nw_institution_relation_revisions r ON r.id=g.relation_ref AND r.child_tenant_id=g.target_tenant_id JOIN nw_tenants child ON child.id=g.target_tenant_id AND child.parent_tenant_id=#{actorTenant} AND child.relation_revision=r.revision JOIN nw_tenants headquarters ON headquarters.id=#{actorTenant} AND r.parent_tenant_id=headquarters.id WHERE g.actor_domain='tenant' AND g.actor_ref=concat('tenant:',#{actorTenant}::text) AND g.action=#{action} AND g.status='active' AND child.status IN('active','warning') AND headquarters.status IN('active','warning') ORDER BY child.id,g.id
